title: Prescribed-qbot nonlinear-path component attribution
question: Which approximated constitutive component in the current production-shaped adaptive provider causes the one-step prescribed-qbot nonlinear-path drift?
implementation_rule: All adaptive components must come from the current b110_adaptive_hydraulic_provider. Exact-component variants may only overwrite selected outputs with the authoritative b110_default_mvg_provider after evaluating the same pressure-head vector.
primary_gate: recover analytical nonlinear iteration and backtracking counts
decision_rule: Attribute control only if restoring one component family to analytical recovers the analytical nonlinear path while the complementary exact-component variant does not.
